Definition: from G2095 and G1014; good-willer; Eubulus, a Christian:--Eubulus.
BiblicalUsage: Eúboulos — Eubulus — was a Christian in Rome who sends greetings to Timothy in Paul's last letter. He is named once, among the few who stood with Paul at the end. His fuller story is on his People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eubulus matters because he stayed: in Paul's last letter, when many had left, Eubulus sends his greeting. I hold that standing with someone at the end is worth being named for.
